summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Enlivex Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reporting the dosing of the first patient in a Phase 2b clinical trial for Allocetra in knee osteoarthritis. The filing contains a press release with clinical milestones, trial design, and CEO commentary. No special-situation corporate transaction is disclosed; it is a routine operational update. The 6-K serves the same function as a U.S. current report on Form 8-K for material events, but here the event is a clinical enrollment update, not a merger, acquisition, restructuring, or other transformative transaction. Because the filing lacks any indication of an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change (the CEO commentary is routine), it is classified as None.
